name: Eclipsera
summary:
# Welcome To Eclipsera!

Welcome to a gigantic, space-sized adventure called Eclipsera! In this adventure, you play as a Droid, found in a blue and toxic planet. Nebu Corp finds you and hires you. Nebu Corp needs your help to find a home for Droids.

# Chapter 1: Elewood

After 39 years, you find a safe planet to live on, except... it's been overtaken by moss. This planet is called "Elewood". You must get rid of the moss and help Nebu Corp move into this planet.

This chapter will be released very soon.
